statement.essentials: The main trunk is short: about a centimetre and a half long before it divides.
statement.anatomy: From the stylomastoid foramen to its first division the trunk measures roughly 14–16 mm on average, with wide variation between people.
statement.clinical: Trunk length was 14.0 mm on average (range 8.6–22.8) in 40 adult cadavers and 16.4 ± 3.2 mm in 23 cadavers.

numbers.label: Trunk length, foramen to first division
Trunk length, foramen to first division

limitations: Two cadaver series that measured slightly differently; the trunk in an individual patient can be much shorter or longer. The model's trunk (17 mm) is inside both ranges.
disagreement: The two series differ by about 2.4 mm in their means.
